create_thread_meta_repository: create a ThreadMetaRepository instance with an async SQLite engine for thread metadata persistence
create_thread_with_assistant: create a thread with an assistant_id to bind a specific agent to the conversation
check_thread_access: check if a user has access to a thread by verifying ownership or using strict mode
update_thread_metadata: update thread metadata by merging new key-value pairs into existing metadata
delete_thread: delete a thread by its thread_id which removes it from the repository
